title: 50-Item Pilot Validation Cohort Report
pilot_objectives: Validate that the 6-stage quality-first pipeline produces zero defect-class items on first pass
Demonstrate that per-item authoring eliminates all 19 template-pipeline defect classes
Establish authoring time-per-item baseline for sprint planning (S837)
Test the pipeline on all 6 blueprint domains and all 5 cognitive levels
Verify governance guard catches any residual defects before certification

cohort_design.composition_rationale: 50 items is 1 batch (governance guard Rule 5 permits ≤30 per change-set; split into 2 batches of 25). Covers all 6 domains, all 5 cognitive levels, both MCQ and case-item formats.

A_External_Financial_Reporting.target: Balance sheet analysis, revenue recognition judgment, cash flow classification, lease vs. buy analysis

B_Planning_Budgeting_Forecasting.target: Flexible budget analysis, cash budget gap analysis, forecast accuracy evaluation, master budget interrelationships

C_Performance_Management.target: Multi-variance reconciliation, transfer pricing evaluation, ROI decomposition, balanced scorecard measure selection

D_Cost_Management.target: Make-or-buy with capacity constraints, CVP multi-product analysis, joint cost allocation comparison, ABC vs traditional comparison

E_Internal_Controls.target: Control deficiency severity assessment, COSO component gap analysis, fraud risk factor evaluation, SoD conflict identification

F_Technology_Analytics.target: Data visualization effectiveness, ERP control weakness, analytics method selection, system implementation risk

Remember.purpose: Baseline — verify pipeline handles simple items cleanly

Understand.purpose: Verify distractor engineering works for conceptual items

Apply.purpose: Core calculation items — verify independent solve + authority citation

Analyze.purpose: PRIMARY TARGET — validate pipeline produces authentic Analyze items

Evaluate.purpose: SECONDARY TARGET — validate pipeline produces authentic Evaluate items

pre_certification_checks: Stage 5 Evidence Review: all items must PASS all structural + content checks
Governance guard Rule 2 scan: 0 DL-008 across all 50 items
Governance guard Rule 6 scan: 0 DL-026 across all 50 items
Independent solve verification: CorrectChoice matches independent calculation for 100% of items
ASC/COSO citation cross-check: all citations verified against known-good standard-to-topic mapping
Distractor uniqueness: Jaccard similarity < 30% between any two distractor explanations on same item
Explanation completeness: all non-CC EW slots >= 50 chars, no template language
post_certification_checks: CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification: all 50 items must achieve HIGH confidence on all 6 dimensions
Item renderability: all 50 items must render correctly in test harness
Learner review simulation: distractors must show correct feedback text

acceptable_residual: DL-003 (Absolute language): acceptable if in distractor explanations where 'never'/'always' is the misconception being flagged
DL-004 (Ambiguity): acceptable if 'generally'/'typically' reflects actual accounting standard language

critical_must_pass: 0 items with missing ExplanationWrong fields (100% required)
50/50 items achieve HIGH confidence on all 6 CAQS dimensions
target_should_achieve: >= 95% of items have < 30% Jaccard similarity between distractor explanations
>= 90% of items have correct ASC/COSO citation on first pass (pre-Stage 5 fix)
>= 90% of items have difficulty label matching independent cognitive assessment
pipeline_efficiency: Time per item: < 15 minutes for Apply items
Time per item: < 25 minutes for Analyze items
Time per item: < 35 minutes for Evaluate items
Certification pass rate: >= 95% of items passing Stage 5 reach Stage 6 certification

batch_1.items: 25 items (5 per domain, mix of Apply + Analyze)
batch_1.purpose: Test pipeline end-to-end on mid-tier items; establish baseline metrics

batch_2.items: 25 items (5 per domain, mix of Analyze + Evaluate + 2 Remember + 5 Understand)
batch_2.purpose: Test pipeline on higher-order items; validate Evaluate-level authoring capability

governance.backup_protocol: Mandatory per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md before any pack file write
